name: 카이렌
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Redesign the provided game hero's COSTUME, HAIR and silhouette as described below while retaining their original human/elf species, class, heroic personality and premium Korean fantasy anime PAINTED original-art finish. Output a perfectly SQUARE 2x2 sprite sheet on GENUINE alpha transparency: exactly FOUR full-body poses of the same redesigned hero, one per quadrant: top-left idle, top-right anticipation, bottom-left strike/casting, bottom-right walking. All four exact same body size, costume, hair and camera angle, orthographic 3/4 facing screen-right. EVERYTHING including weapons remains strictly inside its own quadrant, large 60px transparent gutters along every edge at 1024 size; full figure plus weapon uses ONLY 65% of quadrant height/width. Nothing touches the canvas edge or central divisions. No labels, letters, floor, background, shadow or box borders. Fine luminous material painting, sharply detailed ornament, expressive face, distinct silhouette readable at small game size; no photorealism/plastic. DESIGN: Elf star mage. Preserve the existing feminine elf identity and pointed ears, but make her look wholly distinct from the long lavender-haired mist sage: short angular midnight-navy bob haircut, tiny silver constellation circlet, deep midnight blue geometric high-collar coat with silver star-map embroidery, narrow trousers and tall boots instead of a flowing dress, asymmetric triangular half-cape, compact brass astronomical orrery staff held low, turquoise constellation marks and violet star gems. Slim poised adult mage, no long lavender hair, no gold-trimmed purple dress.
edit_prompt: Edit the supplied redesigned hero sprite sheet. Keep the EXACT character, beautiful painted anime rendering, face, costume, hair and four poses. Make it a clean production SQUARE 2x2 atlas with HUGE transparent gutters: uniformly reduce each complete pose WITH its weapon to 55% of its quadrant dimensions, then place it centered in its own quadrant. No body, spear, sword, cape, staff, hair, glow or sparkle may cross quadrant divisions or touch canvas borders. At 1024 resolution, leave at least 60 pixels transparent on all four sides of EVERY quadrant. Feet matching local baseline in all quadrants, exact same body size. Keep idle top-left, anticipation top-right, attack bottom-left and walk bottom-right. REMOVE all floating spell halos, spell circles, sparks and separate FX painted into the art; retain the weapon itself and fine material edge highlights. No text, no extra hero, no shadow, no floor. Preserve actual transparent alpha and details.
